objective: Calculate the total number of units of a specific product variant available today across all stores in Graz, including stores with zero availability.

params.product_sku: lookup from product_variants WHERE brand='Helly Hansen' AND product_family_name='Helly Hansen Chelsea Evolution Kensington V83-TOZ Work Jacket' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku=product_variants.product_sku AND property_key='color family' AND property_value_text='Blue') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku=product_variants.product_sku AND property_key='size' AND property_value_text='XL')
params.store_record_paths: list of record_path from stores WHERE city='Graz'
